To evade moneylender Zorawar Singh's goons on Holika Dahan night, Popatlal brings a disguised Sundar into the compound, introducing him as "Ruby," a chat friend from Europe. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena lights the bonfire, remembering Champaklal.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
